text:
Maya: Heads up  launch in 10 days. Decision: pause weekly newsletter that week or keep rolling and bolt on launch add-ons? Need call by EOD.
Sam: pause. cluttering inbox hurts launch CTR. run a compact 3-email launch drip to engaged users only.
Priya: agree pause. propose: tiered sends — Tier A (Active 30d) full drip; Tier B (Warm 90d) announcement + how-to; Tier C (Cold 90-365d) re-engage 2 emails then suppress.
Jules: +1. also recommend a pre-launch small A/B on subject lines for tier B to boost opens.
Maya: what's our estimate on list reduction if we suppress cold after re-engage?
ops: quick numbers: total subscribed ~321,400. Active (30d) ~84,200. Warm (30-90d) ~28,600. Cold (90-365d) ~208,600. If we re-engage cold with 2 emails at 4% reactivation -> keep ~8,340; suppress ~200k.
Priya: re-engage copy plan:
- Day0 subject A/B: A="See what's new at Redwood" B="New low-latency benchmark + tips"
- Day4 follow-up: single-CTA to checklist article
- Suppress rule: no opens & no clicks 30 days after follow-up -> tag `suppress_launch_may2026`
Sam: send window test: 10am local vs 2pm local for Warm cohort. monitor by region.
Jules: exclude paying customers, trials <365d, webinar RSVPs, and anyone with snooze_opt_out.
ops: SQL export snippet for the Cold cohort (will run and share CSV):
```sql
SELECT id, email
FROM newsletter_subscribers
WHERE status = 'subscribed'
  AND last_open_at < now() - interval '90 days'
  AND (last_click_at IS NULL OR last_click_at < now() - interval '90 days')
  AND snooze_opt_out = false
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customers WHERE customers.email = newsletter_subscribers.email AND customers.trial_started_at > now() - interval '365 days');
```
Maya: timeline & actions:
- Today EOD: decision to pause weekly (if no objections, we pause).
- Tomorrow 3pm: creative + subjects locked (Priya).
- Ops by tomorrow EOD: CSV + suppression tag upload.
- Marketing: prep exec one-pager showing expected open-rate lift after suppression (~2-3pp).
marketing-bot: Campaign created "may_launch_drip_2026" id cm_2026_may_launch  assets pending.
Maya: OK team, if no objections we'll pause the weekly and run the tiered plan.
Sam: fine by me.
Priya: all good. I'll drop the subject matrix in the doc now.
ops: starting export now, will post link when ready.
